parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resource. This parameter is valid only when `TagKey` is not set in the request. Valid values:

- true

- false

Default value: false

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the resource resides.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- ContainerGroup: ECI instance

- ImageCache: image cache

- DataCache: data cache

- VirtualNode: virtual node

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: A list of tag keys to detach. You can enter up to 20 tag keys.
